verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships 24 official SDKs with first-party docs for React, JS, Vue, Kotlin, Swift and Flutter. All SDKs share the same assignment logic, backed by a 400+ test cross-language suite. Community users report integrating the SDK in minutes to hours. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of an official SDK library evaluating flags (the runtime probe exercised only the SDK payload endpoint).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: 24 SDKs including React, Python, Android, and iOS.
Use the GrowthBook React SDK to evaluate feature flags and run A/B tests in React, including client and server components.
All SDKs use the same assignment logic, so the same attributes always produce the same variation regardless of which SDK you use.
We had Growthbook working in roughly 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code changed.
